title: Cardiovascular Pathophysiology
description: Congenital heart defects, valvular dysfunctions, cardiomyopathies, inflammatory heart diseases, and coronary artery disease with pathophysiology, clinical manifestations, diagnostics, and treatment concepts.

lessons.title: Congenital Heart Defects
lessons.description: Congenital cardiovascular disease and malformation, acyanotic and cyanotic defects, shunt direction, duct-dependent circulation, diagnostics, and correction.

lessons.title: Valvular Dysfunctions
lessons.description: Stenosis, regurgitation, and prolapse across aortic, mitral, tricuspid, and pulmonic valves with causes, pathophysiology, symptoms, diagnostics, and treatment.

lessons.title: Cardiomyopathies
lessons.description: Dilated, restrictive, infiltrative, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathies, including mechanical and electrical dysfunction, causes, symptoms, and diagnostics.

lessons.title: Inflammatory Heart Diseases
lessons.description: Endocarditis, myocarditis, pericarditis, pericardial effusion, tamponade, and constrictive pericarditis with clinical manifestations, diagnostics, and treatment.

lessons.title: Coronary Artery Disease & Atherosclerosis
lessons.description: Plaque development, artery structure, atherosclerotic complications, ischemia, infarction, cardiac biomarkers, and atherothrombotic risk factors.

lessons.title: Module Exam
lessons.description: Comprehensive 50-question module exam covering congenital heart defects, valvular dysfunctions, cardiomyopathies, inflammatory heart diseases, and coronary artery disease.
